item.title: github: Better label management on issues is generally available
item.description:
GitHub says improved label management for issues is now generally available. The update is aimed at making labels easier to organize and find in repositories with large or growing label lists.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: More control over your GitHub-hosted runners
item.description:
GitHub Actions org admins can now control access to GitHub-hosted runners more tightly. They can disable standard hosted-runner labels like ubuntu-latest and add custom labels for finer-grained usage control.

  • Source: GitHub
